Local original brand assets for Grigori by oryth.io.

Files:
- `grigori-mark.svg`: square orbital watcher mark
- `grigori-wordmark.svg`: app/header wordmark with mark + name
- `grigori-report-lockup.svg`: horizontal report/header lockup
- `grigori-favicon.svg`: simplified favicon/app icon

Notes:
- Transparent backgrounds
- SVG-only, no embedded raster assets
- Designed for dark UI surfaces
- Original in-repo artwork for Grigori branding
